title: Incident with Pull Requests, Git Operations and Issues
excerpt: GitHub's Status Page - Incident with Pull Requests, Git Operations and Issues.
content_html:
Resolved

This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available.

Posted Nov 04, 2026 - 11:50 UTC

Monitoring

The degradation affecting Actions has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.

Posted Nov 04, 2026 - 11:43 UTC

Update

The degradation affecting API Requests, Git Operations, Issues and Pull Requests has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability.

Posted Nov 04, 2026 - 11:30 UTC

Update

We're currently working on mitigating elevated errors and intermittent failures affecting GitHub, including Pull Requests, Git Operations, and Issues. Some requests may fail or be delayed while we work to restore service. We'll provide another update as more information becomes available.

Posted Nov 04, 2026 - 11:17 UTC

Update

API Requests is experiencing degraded performance. We are continuing to investigate.

Posted Nov 04, 2026 - 11:11 UTC

Update

We're investigating elevated errors and intermittent failures affecting GitHub including Pull Requests, Git Operations, and Issues. We'll continue to keep users updated as we work toward mitigation.

Posted Nov 04, 2026 - 10:38 UTC

Update

Pull Requests is experiencing degraded availability. We are continuing to investigate.

Posted Nov 04, 2026 - 09:53 UTC

Update

Actions is experiencing degraded performance. We are continuing to investigate.

Posted Nov 04, 2026 - 09:50 UTC

Investigating

We are investigating reports of degraded performance for Git Operations, Issues and Pull Requests

Posted Nov 04, 2026 - 09:49 UTC

This incident affected: Git Operations, API Requests, Issues, Pull Requests, and Actions.
